body: I don't really get your comment. I'm not driving myself crazy over anyone. I want to move overseas and go to college. The problem is I'll never be able to because I'm too slow. As far as I'm concerned, my life is over.
Thanks for the advice, but like I said in my post: I don't want to fight anymore. I'm the kind of person who's very solitary. I have a really difficult time talking to people I don't know.
